caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by five visible black strings attached to its head, arms, and hands, with the strings extending off the top edge of the page. The doll has exaggerated facial features, including large round eyes, prominent red cheeks, and a wide, painted red mouth. The puppet's face and hands are rendered in hues of pink and beige, while its outfit consists of a loose-fitting jumpsuit colored in dark blue with irregular greenish-yellow patches and cuffs. The puppet’s shoes are predominantly beige with greenish accents. Attached to each of the puppet’s hands by thin black lines is a red ball. The marionette's joints at the wrists are clearly mechanical, suggesting articulation. The background of the drawing is a plain, uncolored off-white. The artist's signature, “Ruth G. Ahrens,” appears in the lower right corner of the composition.
title: Jack, the Nimble Juggler
